title: Handmade Clay Dhunuchi
caption:
Sundar laal rang mein hand-painted design. 
Yeh mitti ka dhunuchi hai bada pyaara. 
Puja ghar mein meheke shanti aur bhakti. 
Har ek piece haath se banaya gaya hai. 
Sunhari dhoop mein aur bhi khil utha hai. 
Apne mandir ko sajayein is shubh dhunuchi se. 
DM for price details.
